question: Which theme was celebrated for World Malaria Day on 25 April 2025?

options.text: Time to Beat Malaria: Reinvest, Reimagine, Reignite
Malaria Ends with Us: Reinvest, Reimagine, Reignite
Invest in Malaria-Free Future: Reinvest, Reimagine, Reignite
Zero Malaria Starts with Me: Reinvest, Reimagine, Reignite

solution:
The correct answer is __**Malaria Ends with Us: Reinvest, Reimagine, Reignite**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **World Malaria Day** is an international observance commemorated every year on **25 April** to recognize global efforts to control and eventually eliminate malaria.
 
• For the year **2025**, the theme is **"Malaria Ends with Us: Reinvest, Reimagine, Reignite"**. This theme serves as a clarion call for the global community to bolster its commitment toward a malaria-free world.
 
• The **"Reinvest"** aspect of the theme emphasizes the critical need for increased domestic and international funding to close the gap in malaria financing, which has stagnated in recent years.
 
• The **"Reimagine"** component encourages the development and deployment of innovative tools, such as **next-generation insecticide-treated nets**, **gene-drive mosquitoes**, and more effective **vaccines**.
 
• The **"Reignite"** pillar focuses on restoring political will and community engagement to get the world back on track toward the **2030** targets of the **Global Technical Strategy for Malaria**.
 
• This observance provides an opportunity for affected countries to share their experiences and for international partners to showcase progress in research and development.
